mechanism_narrative: A low federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS <= 0.5%) consistently compresses equity discount rates, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days. This is a persistent market structure effect, not dependent on specific triggers.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are not significantly positive when FEDFUNDS <= 0.5% (t-test p > 0.05) or the Rank IC over 3-year rolling windows is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A rapid increase in the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS 3-month change > 0.5 percentage points) signals imminent monetary tightening, causing short-term equity market sell-offs and negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day forward returns are not significantly negative when FEDFUNDS 3m change > 0.5 (t-test p > 0.05) or the Rank IC over 3-year rolling windows is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous decline in housing starts (HOUST) below 1200.0 thousand units and retail sales (RSAFS) below 440000.0 million dollars indicates broad consumer demand weakness, triggering negative equity sentiment and negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are not significantly negative when HOUST < 1200.0 AND RSAFS < 440000.0 (t-test p > 0.05) or the Rank IC over 3-year rolling windows is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: In a tight labor market (UNRATE below 5.0% and 3-month employment growth (PAYEMS) exceeding 0.5%), late-cycle expansion supports strong corporate earnings, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are not significantly positive when UNRATE < 5.0 AND PAYEMS 3m growth > 0.5 (t-test p > 0.05) or the Rank IC over 3-year rolling windows is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A higher level of industrial production (INDPRO) is associated with stronger economic activity, consistently supporting positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day forward returns are not significantly positive when INDPRO > 100.0 (t-test p > 0.05) or the Rank IC over 3-year rolling windows is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A decline in housing starts (HOUST) below 1200.0 thousand units signals housing market weakness, a leading indicator of economic slowdown, causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are not significantly negative when HOUST < 1200.0 (t-test p > 0.05) or the Rank IC over 3-year rolling windows is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: When the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) exceeds 0.5% and the 3-month CPI change (CPIAUCSL) is negative, high real interest rates trigger equity market negativity, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are not significantly negative when FEDFUNDS > 0.5 AND CPIAUCSL 3m change < 0.0 (t-test p > 0.05) or the Rank IC over 3-year rolling windows is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A decline in industrial production (INDPRO) below 95.0 (2017=100) signals economic contraction, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day forward returns are not significantly negative when INDPRO < 95.0 (t-test p > 0.05) or the Rank IC over 3-year rolling windows is below 0.03.
